verdict: Leads are flowing in; the gap is converting them to cases.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 178 leads at $11.89 per lead on $2,115.60 in spend — the ads are working. The concern this week is that cost per lead rose roughly 15% while spend held flat, and the most recent days show the daily lead rate has not yet returned to its prior baseline of around 6 per day. Separately, 28 of those leads do not appear in your CRM, and none of the 150 contacts recorded there have progressed to an open opportunity — this is an intake and follow-up gap, not an ads problem, and it is the priority being addressed now. Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply over the last 7 days, which is being looked at alongside a planned refresh of local presence activity. Expect the CRM automation work to be in place by end of October, which should close the contact gap and give you a cleaner picture of lead-to-case conversion.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period from paid search, at $11.89 each
total ad spend over the last 28 days, holding steady week over week
local profile actions this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks

watch_item.issue: 28 leads are unaccounted for in the CRM and no contacts have moved to an active opportunity — the bottleneck is intake, not lead volume.
watch_item.fix: CRM automation and contact workflows are being built out now, with a completion target of October 31.
